blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— The P549.58 million Ultra Lotto jackpot has remained unwon in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draw on Tuesday, Nov. 17, 2026. Other major lottery jackpots drawn by the PCSO on Nov. 17, 2026 were also not won. According to the PCSO results, the Ultra Lotto 6/58 draw produced the winning combination 51-56-30-20-29-34, with a jackpot prize of ₱549.58 million. No ticket matched all six numbers.
